description: This file defines a generic Java class 'OperationResult' that extends 'Result'. It encapsulates an operation response with status, payload, cache directives, and an optional resource version, providing methods to create response objects and manage response data.

classes.name: OperationResult
classes.description: A class representing the result of an operation with optional resource version, capable of creating event bus responses.

methods.name: getResourceVersion
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the resource version if present.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates an EventBusMessage response based on the request, with optional resource version included.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Static factory method to create a successful OperationResult with provided status, payload, cache directive, and resource version.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Static factory method to create an empty OperationResult with a given status.
